wiki.title: Suzy Glowiak
wiki.extract: Suzanne Glowiak Hilton is a Democratic member of the Illinois Senate from the 23rd district. The 23rd district includes all or parts of Clarendon Hills, Downers Grove, Elmhurst, Glen Ellyn, Hinsdale, Lisle, Lombard, Oak Brook, Villa Park, Western Springs, Westmont, and Willowbrook. Glowiak narrowly defeated Republican incumbent Chris Nybo in the 2018 general election. She took office January 9, 2019.
